changes_detected: Explored live on Sloneek pre-production 2026-10-01 (FE Angular 21.2.10). Request starts from Me > My absences > 'New absence'; the 'Absence' dialog has a searchable type field, From/To datepickers, an automatic 'Event check' and a 'Create' button.
On the explored account the request is auto-approved ('Approved by superior'); narration therefore says 'approval status' instead of 'pending'.

steps.narration: In this video, you will learn how to request an absence, such as a vacation, in Sloneek.
steps.intent: No action - stay on the dashboard right after login.
steps.must_show: The dashboard with the left menu, including 'My absences' under 'Me', is visible.

steps.narration: In the left menu, under Me, click My absences.
steps.intent: Click 'My absences' in the 'Me' section of the left menu.
steps.must_show: The 'Absence overview' tab of the profile with the 'New absence' button and the balance cards.

steps.narration: Here you can see your balances. Click New absence to open the request form.
steps.intent: Highlight, then click the 'New absence' button in the top right of the absence overview.
steps.must_show: The 'Absence' dialog is open with the 'Absence' type field.

steps.narration: Click the Absence field, search for Vacation (days), and pick it from the list.
steps.intent: Open the 'Absence' field, type 'Vacation (days)' into its search box and click the single remaining option.
steps.must_show: 'Vacation (days)' is selected and the 'From' and 'To' date fields appear.

steps.narration: Now click the From field and pick the first day of your absence in the calendar.
steps.intent: Click 'From' and pick Monday 26 in the datepicker of the current month (October 2026).

steps.narration: Then click the To field and pick the last day you will be away.
steps.intent: Click 'To' and pick Wednesday 28 in the datepicker.
steps.must_show: 'To' shows 10/28/2026 and the 'Event check' shows a green check.

steps.narration: The Event check confirms there is no collision and shows how many days you will draw from your fund.
steps.intent: No click - highlight the 'Event check' block with 'Number of days' and 'Drawing the fund'.
steps.must_show: The 'Event check' block with a green check and the enabled 'Create' button.

steps.narration: Optionally, add an absence note, for example who your colleagues should contact while you are away.
steps.intent: Type 'Family trip, back on Thursday.' into the 'Absence note' field.
steps.must_show: The note text is in the 'Absence note' field.

steps.narration: When everything looks right, click Create to submit your absence.
steps.must_show: The dialog closes and the new absence 10/26/2026 - 10/28/2026 is listed under 'Upcoming absences'.

steps.narration: All done. Your absence now appears under Upcoming absences, together with its approval status.
steps.intent: No click - highlight the new entry under 'Upcoming absences'.
steps.must_show: The new 'Vacation (days)' entry with its status label under 'Upcoming absences'.
